profile.headline: Cyber Security Engineer
profile.summary: Part-time student and part-time parent to a toddler! Currently doing a conversion master's in computer science at the University of Liverpool. Learned Java, JavaScript, React, Redux, Python, and HTML/CSS through the Lambda School Full Stack Web Development boot camp. Have two years of industry experience working with JavaScript, React library, Ruby, and Ruby on Rails framework. Have also taken computer science courses at CCSF.

positions.title: Veterinary Assistant
positions.description:
Assisted in the hospital: 
   Restrained animals for exams, blood draws, injections, and catheter placement
   Monitored cats and dogs post-surgery
   Cleaned hospital area, prepared surgery packs, cleaned and sterilized cages
   Provided instructions to clients post-exam and post-surgery
   Interpreted for Spanish-speaking clients during exams
   Used cornerstone program
   Scripted and prepared medications for patients
   Expressed anal glands, did nail trims
   Typed exam notes for doctors
   Administered vaccines to patients and provided discharge instructions to clients
   Trained new assistants

projects.title: Labs 28 Citrics
projects.description: Finding a place to live is hard! Nomads struggle with finding the right city for them. Citrics is a city comparison tool that allows users to compare cities and find cities based on user preferences.
